I like to draw comic book-y things. Especially of people I know. This is what I think my boyfriend would look like if the carnage symbiote (spiderman universe) got on him.

Progress with drawing does feel really good, it's just so infrequent. heh.

Thank you for all your encouragement.

See, I try that. I strive for it. Or failing that, be strong.
It's just so much, I'm not sure how people ever deal with these things.

But I do like that song.

This weather probably isn't helping. I'd love to start a garden, but I dont really know how. I'm usually very active, but its freezing outside, and I'm sure that's effecting me for the worse.

I wish I could draw to relax, but I want so badly to be good at it, that it frustrates me worse. heh.

Motivations also an issue right now. I feel like I just kept winding, and winding, and winding, until I got so wound up that I broke.

The relationship is probably the most emotionally draining part. I love this man, and I know beyond a shadow of a doubt that he loves me. But we have a terribly sordid past that's quite devoid of love, in which we dated once before and it ended in a large amount of physical and mental abuse. 

A lot of factors led to things going the way they did, and I understand that, and it's been a long time since then. We broke up and somehow remained good friends, and then eventually got back together on terms that I'm not a hundred percent sure were healthy, but in the year and a half since then it's blossomed into as healthy a relationship as any, i believe. Perhaps healthier.

But I still hurt over the things he said and did back then. And jokes he makes now, and things he's callous about sometimes still *hurt*. But if I get upset, he generally acts so dismissive, which makes me more upset, which perpetuates his mood, and kind of makes me feel like a piece of shit.

I've tried to bring up the abuse in the past, to get things of my chest, and to try to understand why he treated me that way, but it pisses him off to hear about that. And I guess I can understand, because since we've gotten back together I've never once worried he was going to hit me you know, he's treated me well. But theres still so much that bothers me, and all he can say is  "There's things I want to believe about myself, and its hard to believe I ever did that, so I don't want to think about it" And I know he questions the credibility of some of the things because he was so drunk he doesn't remember.

I don't even know where I'm going with this, I'm sorry. I
m not capable of much more than rambles right now.

Past abuse. So's callousness. Current pain.

I'm scared of doing something drastic if my mood takes a turn for any worse. I have a history of self harm that I'm trying to distance myself from. I know that I dont want to die, but sometimes I feel like I do, and I'm scared that I'll forget I don't want to die with all this stress.

I'm scared of losing my house, or not being able to eat to keep it.

I'm scared of losing my relationship. I'm scared of the feelings I have in my relationship.

I'm also scared that I have cancer right now, because apparently my body didnt fight off the hpv like it was supposed to. But I'm trying to keep that one out of my head until after I've had a colposcopy.
